label: Sync Gateway Replicator (Server RBAC role)
type: one of six fine-grained Server RBAC roles Couchbase Server 7.0.2 Developer Preview added specifically for Sync Gateway's Admin REST API. Lets the user manage Sync Gateway (ISGR/inter-sync-gateway) replications; does not grant Web Console login.
aliases_note: A1 (rest-api-access.json, rest-api-access-rbac-roles.json) minted this role already spelled to match its internal name; A2 (rest_api_admin.json) independently minted the shorter `role:sgw-replicator` for the identical role - folded as an alias rather than treated as the canonical spelling, since the internal name is the filing convention.
evidence: Role: Sync Gateway Replicator (sync_gateway_replicator) ... The Sync Gateway Replicator role lets the user manage Sync Gateway replications. This role does not let the user log into Couchbase Server Web Console.
note: Round 28 first contact with the 7.0.2+ fine-grained Sync-Gateway-RBAC catalogue extension. Gates the ISGR (inter-sync-gateway replication) management endpoints per rest-api-access-rbac-roles.md's own cross-reference table.
